h1: Custom Glass Koozies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom glass koozies in bulk for your brand. Perfect for events and promotions. Get a fast quote today!
introHtml: Custom glass koozies keep beverages cold while showcasing your logo on a clear, elegant surface. Unlike foam or neoprene options, glass koozies offer a premium feel that stands out at corporate events, trade shows, and retail settings. Use full-color decoration on wraps like the Pint Size Cooler Wrap or the Koozie® britePix® Slim Can Cooler for vibrant brand visibility. Ideal for wine bottles, pint glasses, and slim cans, these koozies combine style with function for any promotional campaign.
heroAltText: Custom glass koozies featuring a full-color printed wrap around a clear glass bottle
